data.what:
The stand-in arm of the withheld-slab test (Supplementary Section S5) in a 2 x 2 design: the registrations (those of record,
or made on the photographs cut at the simulated junction) by the inverse of the exported transform (the fixed point as run,
or exact), with the further cells that hold a stage at the record's. Each cell gives, per brain, the slab SSIM of the
stand-in network (d3p_pseudo) and of the own-b0 network given the stand-in b0 (d3_pseudo) or its own b0 (d3_own), and their
summary over the brains (mean, gain, bootstrap 95 % intervals). without_MR254 repeats the cells over the other 11 brains.
The inputs of each cell are working files of the analysis that the data folder does not hold.
